name: Rebalancer arbitrary call abuses delegated Aave credit
summary: The rebalancer executed caller-supplied target/calldata from its own address with no whitelist, so an attacker had it call Aave Pool.borrow(WAVAX, 7000e18, 2, 0, victim) against the WAVAX borrowing power the victim had delegated to it, then transferred the received WAVAX out with a second arbitrary call.

loss.notes: Seed $64357 values attacker proceeds, not gross unauthorized borrowing. Source-6 reproduces 7000 WAVAX principal charged to the victim; campaign scope and USD valuation remain provisional.

limitations: Pre-exploit runtime hash and archival trace are reproduced; authorization semantics, first fault exercise and complete age history remain unresolved.

sources.note: onchain review: rebalancer 0x7A7bAB45363Efb0394Ff27bfA29bb7C0534cA8C9 created 2025-12-31T18:31:23Z by 0x6fdae9edacc6461b21f71a1a6a420197d2b0c3aa (the delegating victim), not the attack-tx sender 0xf59dc5521f191bcb53a9bcbd1654be81b72ee96f; no EIP-1967 events, 108.5 days old. 6,999.91 WAVAX x $9.194 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama coingecko:avalanche-2) = $64,357.

Partial review, not promotion. Reproduce source-1 eth_getTransactionReceipt using https://api.avax.network/ext/bc/C/rpc. WAVAX 0xb31f66aa3c1e785363f0875a1b74e27b85fd66c7 log 26 moves 7000000000000000000000 raw units from aToken 0x6d80113e533a2c0fe82eabd35f1875dcea89ea97 to rebalancer. Pool 0x794a61358d6845594f94dc1db02a252b5b4814ad Borrow log 27 records 7000 WAVAX principal on behalf of victim 0x6fdae9edacc6461b21f71a1a6a420197d2b0c3aa. Debt-token 0x4a1c3ad6ed28a636ee1751c69071f6be75deb8b8 Mint log 24 has value 7047127868162481439549 and balanceIncrease 47127868162481439548, so accrued prior interest must not be counted as newly stolen principal. The attacker helper 0xe44eea4c6c2085d590a4a6bea01cf83e87a37be5 separately borrows 0.01 WAVAX twice (logs 20/43) and repays 20000000000000001 raw units (log 59); rebalancer sends it 7000.02 WAVAX in log 46. Final log 77 pays attacker 6999.911443798736841214 WAVAX after other transaction flows: this is not gross victim depletion. eth_getCode(rebalancer,83324252) returns 3775 bytes with the recorded hash. Etherscan V2 getsourcecode returns unverified; txlist for rebalancer returns only deployment, which does not establish absence of internal calls. Initial Python default User-Agent requests returned HTTP403; adding User-Agent: ossification-dataset-review resolved the configured Avalanche RPC and callTracer is available. Official public RPC lacks debug_traceTransaction. Unresolved: actual executed authorization defect, earliest abuse, latest causal code/state change, and complete campaign loss. Next: obtain matching source or archival traces, reconstruct BorrowAllowanceDelegated history for victim/rebalancer and compare state before/after; distinguish delegation creating a vulnerable trust relationship from merely exposing credit to a preexisting flaw. Reconcile all victim Borrow/Repay events and obtain an onchain historical AVAX/USD quote before replacing the seed USD estimate.

Follow-up: configured callTracer reproduces two helper calls to rebalancer selector 0xb2a13230; first contains Aave borrow on behalf of victim and second transfers the 7000.02 WAVAX balance to helper. Opcode frames read/write only slot 0 (0 -> 1 -> 0), consistent with a reentrancy guard; matching deployment/pre-exploit hashes and absence of DELEGATECALL/CALLCODE/SELFDESTRUCT support fixed runtime, but other reachable state paths still require review. eth_getLogs over 74810239..83324253, BorrowAllowanceDelegated topic 0xda919360433220e13b51e8c211e490d148e61a3bd53de8c097194e458b97f3e1 with padded rebalancer as topic2, returns exactly three events: victim unlimited delegation in 0xbf3bbbaba3007c49fd3e9a2d3262dbac8e19dafb03517a9de6ab76af04509855 at block 74827659, and helper grant/revoke in source-1. At block 83324253, Pool.ADDRESSES_PROVIDER() returns 0xa97684ead0e402dc232d5a977953df7ecbab3cdb; getPriceOracle() returns 0xebd36016b3ed09d4693ed4251c67bd858c3c7c9c; getAssetPrice(WAVAX) returns 916047860 and BASE_CURRENCY_UNIT() returns 100000000, an onchain $9.16047860 quote. Source-7 reports whitehat front-running and recovery before withdrawal, which raises admission/attribution uncertainty rather than establishing stolen gross loss. Observed custody: 0xfabb46bcf977bb5d411ceaed9bd2f92041aba2a78ff1dfb3bec5cbc0b79156fe forwards all 6999.911443798736841214 WAVAX from recorded sender to 0x36b112875f921e51f5ea8ff39b374960694d21b3. Etherscan tokentx for that recipient over 83324253..85000000 has 19 incoming transfers and no outgoing Transfer events; this alone cannot exclude native unwrapping/return. Next: identify recipient/control and trace native/token disposition to resolve preventative rescue versus theft followed by recovery; inspect native withdrawals and victim debt repayments, then complete first-use/external-allowance history before promotion.

limitations: Gross initial unauthorized principal differs from net attacker proceeds; full campaign scope and historical USD valuation require review.
Unverified runtime still requires full root-cause, first-use and causal delegation/configuration review; configured archival traces are available with explicit User-Agent.
Primary report describes whitehat rescue; whether source-1 is theft followed by recovery or preventative intervention remains unresolved. Source-8 preserves custody evidence and next steps.
